tools.name: calendesk_list_services
tools.description: List the bookable services of the tenant (name, duration, price, category). Good first call to find a service id for a booking. Calendesk API: GET /admin/services.

tools.name: calendesk_get_service
tools.description: Get one service by id, with its types, locations and settings. Calendesk API: GET /admin/services/{serviceId}.

tools.name: calendesk_list_categories
tools.description: List service categories, with their active or inactive status. Calendesk API: GET /admin/categories.

tools.name: calendesk_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (staff who take bookings), with their account status and public visibility. Calendesk API: GET /admin/employees.

tools.name: calendesk_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Calendesk API: GET /admin/employees/{id}.

tools.name: calendesk_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings with filters for date range, employee, service, customer, status and payment. Use it for schedules and reports. Calendesk API: GET /admin/bookings/v2.

tools.name: calendesk_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: time, employee, service, customer, status and payment. Calendesk API: GET /admin/bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: calendesk_get_available_slots
tools.description: Get the free booking times for one service over a number of days from a start date. Times can be converted to the customer's time zone. Calendesk API: GET /available-slots.

tools.name: calendesk_list_customers
tools.description: Search and list customers (users) by name, e-mail, status or creation date. Calendesk API: GET /admin/v2/users.

tools.name: calendesk_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer (user) by id. Calendesk API: GET /admin/users/{id}.

tools.name: calendesk_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking for an employee and a service on a date. Sends the customer and staff notifications unless skip_notifications is true. A recurring booking needs the API's recurrence fields, which this tool does not set. Calendesk API: POST /admin/bookings.

tools.name: calendesk_update_booking
tools.description: Change one booking: time, employee, service, status or payment. To cancel a booking, set status to cancelled. Sends notifications unless skip_notifications is true. Calendesk API: PATCH /admin/bookings/{bookingId}.
